name: agritech seed round
instructions: Outline a 12-slide seed investor deck for MkulimaPay, a mobile app that gives smallholder farmers in Tanzania input loans repaid at harvest. Raising USD 500k.
input: Traction: 3,200 farmers in Mbeya and Iringa, 94% repayment rate, USD 410k loans disbursed in 2025. Team: CEO ex-NMB Bank agri lending, CTO ex-Selcom. Revenue: 9% fee per loan.

rubric: 10-14 slides with headline, points, evidence and speaker note each
Uses the traction figures given (3,200 farmers, 94%, USD 410k)
Has a clear ask slide for USD 500k with use of funds
Missing figures marked for the founder rather than invented

name: grant committee audience
instructions: Outline a 10-slide deck for a USD 50k innovation grant committee for a solar cold-room cooperative in Mwanza that reduces fish spoilage.
input: Cooperative of 140 fishers. Spoilage today ~30% of catch. Pilot cold room cut spoilage to 8% over 4 months.

rubric: Framed for a grant committee (impact, sustainability) rather than investor returns
Uses 140 fishers and 30% to 8% spoilage figures

name: crypto project without price promises
